title: Pilot Programme for SMRT Taxis to be Equipped with Booster Seats for Young Children
what_it_is: Pilot Programme for SMRT Taxis to be Equipped with Booster Seats for Young Children

sections.label: SMRT taxi booster seat pilot
sections.summary: About 1,750 SMRT taxis had booster seats, but utilisation was low due to few commuter requests, and SMRT will update on usage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: About 1,750 SMRT taxis were equipped with booster seats for young children.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: However, the utilisation rate for these booster seats was low, as there were very few requests for the booster seats from commuters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The booster seats remain in the taxis, and SMRT will provide further updates on their usage soon.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: If there are other taxi companies who are keen to conduct similar pilots, LTA will be glad to consider.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We know that children are getting injured because they are not in child car seats during the accident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We know that being in a child car seat can reduce the incidents of death by over 50% if you are in a car seat.

sections.label: Private vehicle child car seat penalty
sections.summary: For private vehicles, a child not in a car seat could result in jail.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For private vehicles, if your child is not in a car seat, you could go to jail for it.

sections.label: Taxis and child restraint permutations
sections.summary: It is not feasible for taxis to be fully equipped with different permutations of child restraints for boarding children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: First, it is not feasible for taxis to be fully equipped with different permutations of child restraints to cater to the children who may board the taxi.

sections.label: Child seat rule and economic situation
sections.summary: Imposing this is not wise in the current economic situation, but parents can use private hire cars included in the Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: And I do not think it is wise to impose this during this current economic situation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But, parents have option of using private hire cars, or PHCs, already, as they are included in this Act.
